intent: Analyze Gartner GEAR buyer inquiry data focused on ServiceNow commercial and economic friction to understand buyer themes, supplied categories, evidence, sensitivity, and slide-ready outputs.
description: A Buyer Voice schema for ServiceNow commercial-friction inquiry analysis. This is not a vendor-score schema; it models buyer discovery items, commercial themes, category assignment, trajectory, evidence, figure provenance, sensitivity review, and report outputs.

source_dataset.source_file: buyervoice/Corpora - Raw GEAR/GEAR - ServiceNow Commercial Friction Set.csv
source_dataset.primary_analytical_question: What commercial and economic friction are enterprise buyers raising about ServiceNow?

legend_sections.label: Dataset & Pull
legend_sections.definition: The canonical GEAR export and its formatted NotebookLM projection.
legend_sections.use_in_analysis: Treat the raw CSV as the source of truth and the formatted files as ingestion-friendly views.

legend_sections.label: Interaction Record
legend_sections.definition: One Gartner buyer interaction, proposal review, document review, or sample inquiry.
legend_sections.use_in_analysis: Commercial-friction findings must trace to specific buyer interactions.

legend_sections.label: Commercial Discovery Item
legend_sections.definition: A buyer-raised cost, pricing, packaging, licensing, renewal, negotiation, business-case, or alternative signal.
legend_sections.use_in_analysis: Discover these bottom-up before assigning to supplied categories.

legend_sections.label: Buyer Profile
legend_sections.definition: Region, sector, role, persona, and market context for the asking organization.
legend_sections.use_in_analysis: Supports buyer composition and flags when a theme is concentrated in one role, sector, or region.

legend_sections.label: Supplied Category
legend_sections.definition: One of the five analysis buckets used after bottom-up discovery.
legend_sections.use_in_analysis: Use as an organizing taxonomy, not as the initial search space.

legend_sections.label: Theme & Trajectory
legend_sections.definition: A commercial-friction theme with qualitative spread and quarter-by-quarter trajectory.
legend_sections.use_in_analysis: Rate spread and trajectory across 1Q26, 2Q26, and partial 3Q26 with the July caveat visible.

legend_sections.label: Figure Provenance
legend_sections.definition: Traceability for numerical figures, commercial claims, and account-specific cost examples.
legend_sections.use_in_analysis: Mark single-account and multi-account figures before any slide-facing use.

legend_sections.label: Sensitivity Review
legend_sections.definition: Handling rules for negotiation leverage, audit-risk tactics, client-identifying detail, and cost-avoidance findings.
legend_sections.use_in_analysis: Flag sensitive findings for internal handling before turning them into client-facing guidance.

legend_sections.label: Slide Output
legend_sections.definition: The report-ready matrix, deep-dive card, or narrative aligned to the Buyer Voice deck outcomes.
legend_sections.use_in_analysis: Produce slide-facing outputs only after discovery, category assignment, evidence, provenance, and sensitivity steps are complete.

validation_principles: The five categories are naming buckets, not the search space.
July-only 3Q26 data is partial and directional.
Every numerical figure needs provenance marking.
Negotiation leverage, audit-risk, and cost-offset tactics require sensitivity review.
Market statistics and analyst recommendations must not be mixed into buyer-voice findings unless explicitly labeled.
